findings.title: Report subquery scoping
findings.description: The complex subquery in $availableMap groups by item_id and branch_id but the subqueries join back to the outer stock_movements table by these same columns. Verify that the grouping produces one row per product-branch combination and doesn't produce duplicates when multiple locations exist under a single branch.

findings.title: calculateBranchAvailableQty() picks best location balance
findings.description: The method iterates through all locations assigned to the user's branch(es) and returns the highest balance, not the sum. In a multi-location branch, if Location A has 120 units and Location B has 50 units, the method returns 120. Confirm this is intentional for the Sell tab (i.e., the user can sell from the best-stocked location) and not a logic gap that should sum across all branch locations.
